faq_seo_description: Common questions about easyquran: cost, accounts, the Arabic script, offline reading, translations and what is coming next.
faq_free_answer: Yes, and it stays free. No ads, no paid tier, no upsell inside the reader. If we ever need help with hosting we'll ask openly rather than sell your attention.
faq_account_answer: Not to read — the reader opens straight away. A free optional account syncs your bookmarks and reading sessions across your devices. Notes stay in this browser and never leave it.
faq_script_question: Which Arabic text do you use?
faq_script_answer: The Uthmani script, matching the standard printed mushaf. If you spot a discrepancy, email support@easyquran.fyi — we treat script accuracy as the highest priority in the project.
faq_offline_answer: Once the app has loaded, the surahs you've opened stay available offline.
faq_next_answer: easyquran is growing into a complete platform. On the way: hadith and their explanations, an audio player and a deeds feature — followed by native desktop and mobile apps.
faq_translations_answer: The complete Qur'an is available in 378 translation sources across 105 languages, ayah by ayah or as continuous reading, each credited to its source. Two Arabic tafsir sources are offered as commentary alongside the Arabic text; more are planned.
faq_backup_question: How do I back up my bookmarks?
faq_backup_answer: Signed out, they live in your browser. Sign in — free — and they sync to your account and your other devices. Changes made while you're offline are kept on this device and sync the next time you're online.

legal_privacy_seo_description: What easyquran collects, what stays on your device, and the choices you have.
legal_privacy_summary: The short version: usage analytics and crash reports are off unless you turn them on in Settings. Personal reading insights are always on, and they are yours alone. Push notifications run only if you enable them. Bookmarks and reading history sync only when you sign in, and your notes never leave this device.
legal_privacy_collect_body: Usage analytics and crash reports go through Google Firebase, and only after you turn analytics on in Settings. Google Analytics then sets an identifier for your browser and sees coarse screens, which features get used, and error messages. It never records which surahs or verses you read. Reading insights are separate and always on: easyquran counts the verses you read and how long you spend on them, so it can show your most-read surahs and verses, your time read, and pick up where you left off. These insights are shown only to you.
legal_privacy_accounts_body: Reading needs no account. If you create one, we store your email address and the sign-in details for it, and your bookmarks, folders, reading history and reading insights sync across your devices. Notes stay in your browser and are never synced. Administrators can reach account data when running or securing the service. You can delete your account yourself from the Account page. Deletion removes your account data from the live database and from storage straight away, including your sign-in details, sessions, devices, bookmarks, reading history, comments, uploaded media and avatar. Your posts stay without your name attached. Audit, moderation and enforcement records, the deletion record and any data under a legal hold are kept. This is a logical erasure; we make no claim of physical deletion, including from backups.
legal_privacy_device_body: Until you sign in, bookmarks, notes, your reading history and reading insights are stored in your browser. Signing in adds the bookmarks on this device to your account. Your notes stay on this device either way.
legal_privacy_hosting_body: Our server and content delivery network handle your IP address and standard request details, such as browser type and requested page. We use these to run the service and to limit abuse, including rate limits and the records of them.
legal_privacy_notifications_body: If you enable notifications, we store a token for your browser so messages reach it. You can turn notifications off at any time in your device or browser settings.
legal_privacy_children_body: When you create an account with email, we ask for your date of birth and keep only whether you are under 18. For accounts under 18, we keep no device records or push tokens, store no reading events, and do not allow comments. Accounts created with a third-party sign-in are not asked for a date of birth.
legal_privacy_choices_body: You can use easyquran without an account, keep analytics off, decline notifications, and, if you have an account, delete it yourself from the Account page. Clearing your browser data removes anything stored locally.
legal_privacy_changes_body: If this policy changes we will update the date at the top.

legal_terms_seo_description: The terms that apply to the easyquran website and reader.
legal_terms_acceptance_body: By using easyquran you agree to these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the app. They apply to the website and the reader alike.
legal_terms_service_body: easyquran provides a Qur'an reading interface, search, bookmarks and personal notes, without warranty of uninterrupted availability. easyquran is made by oxlabs and run by hmziq.rs.
legal_terms_accuracy_body: We take great care with the Arabic text and translations, but errors are possible. For matters of ruling or recitation, please rely on a printed mushaf and qualified scholarship.
legal_terms_content_body: Notes and bookmarks you create remain yours. Notes never leave your device. If you use sync, you give us permission to store and transfer your bookmarks and reading sessions solely to provide that feature. We claim no licence over your content beyond running the service. If you delete your account, your posts stay without your name attached, as the Privacy Policy describes.
legal_terms_use_body: Please do not attempt to disrupt the service, scrape it at abusive volume, or redistribute the app while presenting it as your own product. Quoting and sharing verses is, of course, encouraged. We may remove content you post, or restrict an account, when it breaks these terms or the law, and rate limits apply. If you think we got a decision wrong, contact us.
legal_terms_third_party_body: Translations and other source texts remain the property of their respective holders.
legal_terms_liability_body: The app is provided 'as is'. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from its use, including loss of locally stored notes or bookmarks.
legal_terms_contact_body: Questions about these terms can be sent to legal@easyquran.fyi.
